features_to_verify: 畳敷きの空間と古い木箱を使った本棚
subject.rights_status: no authorization or store photography supplied

goal: Avoid reproducing the left-copy/right-photo scroll-section template; preserve useful store, access and enquiry information in original structures.
protected_constraints: three distinct page-level grammars, not just palettes
do not imitate any of CP-001..009
no invented schedule, phone, address, book inventory or programme
images and labels are conceptual; verify merchant facts before sales or publishing
usable mobile layout cannot require hover or drag
readable real text and visible access/contact if officially verified

comparison_basis.reason: Prior case notes describe composition but lack standardized section-level layout maps; cannot defensibly assign numeric similarity scores to them.

proposals.name: 引き出す舞台 / The Pulling Stage
proposals.core_device: 紙芝居の木枠から絵を引き出し物語を開く

first_screen.composition: 中央に木製の舞台一つ。左上は店名と短い案内。画面の主役は枠の中の一枚の絵。通常の左右文章＋写真Heroにはしない
first_screen.position_of_type: 舞台の左右・上下に小さく配置。主張するのは店名より中央の舞台

sections.info: 店の位置づけ・入口となる選択肢
一枚ずつ引き出すような体験の説明
本棚の索引をモチーフにしたジャンル紹介。実在情報は要確認
店で過ごす時間を短文で伝える
公式情報確認後の店舗情報・連絡方法

proposals.desktop_strategy: 横長の舞台の右へ絵をずらす。次へ／前へボタンと文章を別DOM要素で出す
proposals.mobile_strategy: 舞台の枠を縦方向に組み替え、次の絵はボタンで進める。ドラッグ操作専用にしない
proposals.accessibility: Scene navigation as buttons, keyboard and reduced-motion fallback; real text separate from pictures
no_go: large brand wordmark with photo overlapped like Mond
proposals.main_risk: 舞台演出が重いと店の情報が分かりづらい。アクセスは独立した見やすい面にする

proposals.name: 本棚が地図になる / Shelf Atlas
proposals.core_device: 大小の背表紙が店を探索する索引と道順になる

first_screen.composition: 画面いっぱいの異なる幅の背表紙。店名は棚板の上に小さく。本のジャンルを案内として読ませ、中心Hero写真は置かない
first_screen.position_of_type: 見出しは縦の背表紙文字と棚のラベルで形成

sections.info: 探索しやすい本のカテゴリ
選んだジャンルを余白の注釈で説明
本棚の奥に紙芝居舞台が現れる
畳の落ち着きを空白で伝える
貸出カード風に店舗情報を整理。貸出サービスを示唆しない

proposals.desktop_strategy: 画面に背表紙の索引を広げ、選択中のカテゴリーだけ隣の注釈へつなぐ
proposals.mobile_strategy: 背表紙が読みにくい場合は縦の見出し付き目次へ置き換える。小さい文字を回転縮小しない
proposals.accessibility: Index as list of buttons/links; large tap targets; do not require horizontal scroll to locate access
proposals.main_risk: 情報が多すぎると読みづらい。ページ冒頭に閲覧方法と店の説明を短く示す

proposals.name: 畳の間を歩く / The Quiet Rooms
proposals.core_device: 畳の間取りと襖の開閉をページの探索順にする

first_screen.composition: 俯瞰の畳の間を一つの地図として表示。床に配置した三つの入口から「紙芝居・本・時間」を選ぶ
first_screen.position_of_type: 部屋の名前が案内であり、単一の巨大見出しを主役にしない

sections.info: 店の世界と3つの入り口
襖を開けた先に舞台を発見
見開きに選書の考え方と店舗固有の題材
余白を中心に本を読む時間を伝える
入口に戻り、情報欄としてアクセスを示す

proposals.desktop_strategy: 俯瞰図の扉を選んで各内容へジャンプ。普通の縦スクロールでも全情報へアクセス可能
proposals.mobile_strategy: 平面図をそのまま縮小せず、部屋を縦に並べた探索リストへ変換
proposals.accessibility: Clickable room names as real buttons/links; no reliance on hover; non-animated contents remain usable
no_go: round quilt motif as section decoration
proposals.main_risk: 畳・間取りは実店舗の実際の寸法や構造を示す図ではないと明記する

visual_preference_20261027.owner_feedback: 悪くなったな、これがよかった
visual_preference_20261027.selected_reference: Original full-color three-way comparative board, panel B: 本棚が地図になる, including adjacent desktop and smartphone visual mockups

user_uploaded_thumbnail.name: image(20261027-104455).png
user_uploaded_thumbnail.storage: current ChatGPT user upload; image binary is not committed to GitHub

accepted_visual_features: Full-bleed warm, atmospheric photographic bookshelf hero, with the shop identity integrated into the environment
Asymmetric floating cream paper annotation over the hero, not a bare schematic shelf-control panel
Distinct second beat featuring an aligned row of varied book spines with tactile colors and print
Further editorial chapters with intimate bookstore and kamishibai photography; readable paper notes and strongly varied scale
Warm amber lighting, dark natural wood and paper grain contrasted with restrained cream negative space
Mobile layout with the same recognizable atmosphere and chapter rhythm; not merely a wireframe
visual_preference_20261027.rejected_outcome: The later seven-clickable-spine research HTML prototype passed basic interaction/browser checks but was aesthetically judged worse than the original panel B. Do not treat technical structure originality as evidence of visual superiority.
visual_preference_20261027.future_implementation_policy: Restore the preferred visual composition first. Add real interaction to selected spines and/or annotations only where it does not distort the photographed shelf, book row, typographic hierarchy or editorial chapter rhythm. Produce a side-by-side visual fidelity comparison with uploaded reference on desktop/mobile before considering approval.
visual_preference_20261027.approval_scope: visual direction/reference preference only, not acceptance of implemented website or client/publication approval

visual_fidelity_v2.reference: user-selected original colored three-way comparison panel B, not rejected poster or over-mechanical bookshelf implementation
visual_fidelity_v2.method: Photo crops from earlier AI-generated concept, independent HTML/CSS paper overlays, live 9-spine annotation selector, paper-theater curtain. PC/mobile responsive CSS. Not a full screenshot embedded as the website.
visual_fidelity_v2.fidelity_evaluation: Qualitatively closer to the original B in warm bookshelves, floating paper note, colored spine strip, bookstore and kamishibai section progression, and visit-note ending. Not pixel-accurate and some photographs are upscaled concept crops.
limitations: Some photos are low-resolution extracted AI-generated composition material and cannot represent real store
Some original generated visual text remains within photographic crops
Chrome/Chromium only, 9 sizes, no Safari/Firefox or physical devices
No Next.js, public deployment, copyright/client approval
B-proposal beauty is a user-selected reference, not approval of v2 outcome
